issues.extracted: Total column (includes component unit St. Paul Cottages)
issues.on_page: Subtotal (primary programs) vs Component Unit St. Paul Cottages vs Total
issues.issue: All figures use the Total column, which adds the discretely presented component unit (e.g. dwelling rent 61,608, debt 489,636) to the primary government. The Total also keeps 'Equity Interest in St. Paul Cottages' 29,859 while consolidating the Cottages' own assets. A person should decide whether to use the Subtotal (primary government) instead. No decision_needed entry exists.
